## DictionaryAbsenceEvidenceSchema variable

Evidence that an app's scripting dictionary has no collection for a resource the manifest declares: what was looked for, what the dictionary showed, and which app build on which macOS version it holds for.

**Signature:**

```typescript
DictionaryAbsenceEvidenceSchema: z.ZodObject<
  {
    source: z.ZodLiteral<'dictionary'>
    bundleId: z.ZodString
    appVersion: z.ZodString
    osVersion: z.ZodString
    term: z.ZodString
    finding: z.ZodEnum<{
      'no-class': 'no-class'
      'not-an-element': 'not-an-element'
    }>
  },
  z.core.$strict
>
```
